fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) is developing an AI assistant capable of performing tasks across multiple apps and websites to compete with Meta (META)'s Muse, potentially supporting the 27% stock price gain from early this year.
fields.summary_ko.1: UBS analyst maintains AAPL at 'Neutral' rating with target price of $340, suggesting approximately 2% downside from current price, while Wall Street consensus target is approximately $345, in line with current trading levels.
